title: Define data minimisation, aggregation, and retention contract V1
businessObjective: Keep analytics useful without copying raw guest-interaction telemetry into AI OS or creating continuous per-event workloads.
technicalObjective: Implement one closed static V1 structural authority, one canonical finite minimisation/retention policy, and one runtime-safe classification deep module for metadata-only candidates; perform no data access, lifecycle action, persistence, workflow, or production operation.
assumptions: Raw page views, clicks, scrolls, and marketing telemetry remain in their source analytics systems.
The candidate is metadata only and contains no guest, booking, payment, credential, prompt, telemetry, or evidence payload.

Classification is non-authoritative and cannot establish legal retention, action due-ness, persistence permission, lifecycle permission, AI invocation permission, compliance, or production-write authority.
P3-005 may later consume this static authority with separately approved fixture-only retention configuration and capacity authority; P2-006 performs no lifecycle operation.
acceptanceCriteria: The Draft 2020-12 schema is closed and the canonical policy fixes exactly four source-only raw categories, twelve AI-OS-eligible semantic categories, ten artifact/retention classes, four aggregation intervals, six non-authoritative action candidates, the metadata-only candidate, and exclusive valid decision variants from the approved GOV-050 design.

The sole public export is `classifyDataGovernanceCandidate(candidate)`; it obtains committed authority internally, accepts no caller-supplied schema/policy/configuration/validator/adapter/dependency, ignores extra JavaScript arguments, returns recursively frozen plain data, does not mutate input, and never throws for malformed, hostile, cyclic, getter/proxy, or deeply nested input.

Raw page views, clicks, scrolls, and marketing telemetry classify only as source-system-managed with no AI OS storage, queue, workflow, or AI intent; permanent per-interaction rows, individual-interaction queue/workflow/AI, and individual-system-event AI invocation fail closed.

Only hourly/daily aggregates, essential booking lifecycle events, anomalies/incidents, investigations/recommendations, proposals/approvals/executions/outcomes, and required audit evidence can become AI-OS-eligible metadata classifications, with exact source/category/artifact/interval/action mappings.

Retention classification is candidate-only: no duration or due-state is inferred; scheduled delete, aggregate, archive, transfer eligibility, and retain mappings do not execute or authorize an action, and missing future retention authority remains fail closed.

Append-only audit and failed-attempt history reject delete, aggregate, rewrite, or weakened-preservation descriptors and can only classify as retain, archive, or transfer candidates that preserve the original protected record.

Deterministic reason codes follow the exact GOV-050 precedence; internal authority failure is singleton, authority injection is detected before ordinary structure, malformed input always returns a schema-valid fail-closed decision, and accepted decisions explicitly deny action and production-write authority.

The exact validator compiles both committed authorities, checks exact finite mappings and decision exclusivity, validates every returned decision, covers the focused negative and hostile-input matrix, confirms the core import boundary, and demonstrates that weakened caller dependencies cannot redirect authority.

Documentation states the schema/semantic limits: the contract cannot prove payload minimisation, aggregation correctness, legal retention, due state, external preservation, source behavior, or completed lifecycle action.

No data source, guest data, provider/storage SDK, filesystem, clock, environment, credential, network, database, SQL, migration, RLS, queue, workflow, scheduler, AI invocation, deletion, archive, transfer, local-storage write, audit rewrite, or production write is accessed or implemented.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P2-006 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: GOV-051 exact validator admission is terminal before activation
raw-telemetry, cardinality, protected-history, authority-injection, and never-throw regression matrix
final-head CI explicitly runs the exact P2-006 validator
solEscalationTriggers: Any guest/personal/booking/payment data access, legal-retention interpretation, lifecycle action, audit/failed-history weakening, storage/provider integration, SDK, filesystem/clock/environment authority, network/service, SQL/migration/RLS, AI invocation, or production operation is out of scope and requires a separate approved packet.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the static P2-006 schema, canonical policy, classification module, validator, product documentation, P2-006 task state, risk update, and P2-006 evidence; preserve GOV-050/GOV-051 planning/admission history, P1-003/P2-001/P2-005 terminal records, all protected audit and failed-attempt history, canonical sources, immutable snapshot, and external systems. No external state exists to roll back.
